title: Sustainable self-assembled gum tragacanth hydrogel for eco-efficient uranium recovery from contaminated water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3182-3190
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00386E, Paper
Lan Lei, Rui Zhang, Rui-Xiang Bi, Zhi-Hai Peng, Xin Liu, Tie-Ying Shi, Li Zhang, Ru-Ping Liang, Jian-Ding Qiu
Self-assembled hydrogel composite integrating gum tragacanth functionalized with amidoxime groups and exfoliated two-dimensional montmorillonite was synthesized for the efficient recovery of uranium from contaminated water.
